children: Rocket Lab USA (RKLB) shares fell about 5% Friday as investors weighed the effect of a $1.94 billion stock sale used to help finance the company's planned purchase of Iridium Communications.

The company raised roughly $1.944 billion through its at-the-market program by selling about 29.3 million shares. The proceeds are intended mainly for the cash portion of the Iridium transaction, which Rocket Lab expects to complete in mid-2027, subject to regulatory approvals. The financing was completed on Sept. 15.

The funding also reshaped the debt arrangements surrounding the deal. Iridium amended its existing credit facility, providing $1.775 billion of term loans that can remain in place after a change of control. Rocket Lab also terminated a $3.6 billion bridge loan commitment after securing the new funding.

The added shares have raised concerns about dilution for existing holders, putting pressure on the stock despite the financing progress. Rocket Lab said excess proceeds, if any, could support future acquisitions, growth initiatives, working capital and general corporate purposes.

title: Rocket Lab stock tumbles after massive $1.94 billion equity raise
